entities.summary: Agapitus Enuyehnyoh Nfon is a Cameroonian Catholic prelate who serves as the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kumba, in Cameroon since 15 March 2016. Before that, from 8 April 2011 until 15 March 2016, he was auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Bamenda, Cameroon. Pope Benedict XVI appointed him bishop. He was consecrated by Piero Pioppo, Titular Archbishop of Torcello, on 31 May 2011. On 15 March 2016, Pope Francis created the Catholic Diocese of Kumba and made it a suffragan of the Metropolitan Province of Bamenda.
